purpose: Learn non-final entry buttons such as Apply, Book, Register, Checkout, or Continue to form.
applies_when: A button opens a new flow but is not the final submit.
The next page may be same-site, external, login-gated, or account-gated.
The runtime must inspect the new flow before filling or submitting.
trace_requirements: Record before-click URL or app state when available.
Record post-click URL or app state.
Record whether the opened flow is same-site, external, login/account/privacy gated, or unsupported.
Record that entry click is not final submit.
success_conditions: Entry flow opens and is classified.
External/login/account/privacy/captcha/upload boundaries are reported as review stops.

seek_source.lesson: SEEK Apply and Quick Apply are open_apply_flow actions, not final submit; external ATS and account/privacy steps stop for review.
